THE JOURNEY AT A GLANCE

Make every
day count.

This safari takes you through the country’s most iconic parks, Tarangire, Serengeti, & Ngorongoro Crater. Enjoy close encounters with elephants, lions, and countless other wildlife as you travel across breathtaking landscapes. With comfortable lodges and expert guides, this adventure offers the perfect mix of excitement, beauty, and relaxation in the heart of Africa.

Duration6 days
Published styleLuxury
PlanningPersonalised
YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1Arrival in Arusha

Settle into Arusha, a friendly city surrounded by beautiful scenery and the towering peak of Mount Meru. It’s the perfect spot to relax before your safari & stroll through bustling markets, try some local Tanzanian food, and enjoy the peaceful views as you get ready for the adventures that lie ahead in the wild.

Stay Gran Meliá Arusha

Meals & drinks Dinner (Breakfast & lunch not included) Drinking water (Other drinks not included)

02DAY 2Tarangire National Park

Spend the day discovering the magic of Tarangire National Park, a quiet and beautiful place filled with towering baobab trees and herds of gentle elephants. As you wander through its golden plains, you’ll see zebras grazing, giraffes moving gracefully between the trees, and if you’re lucky, lions resting in the shade. The peaceful atmosphere and stunning landscapes make Tarangire a truly unforgettable part of your safari adventure.

Stay Lake Burunge Baobab Tented Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included Drinking water (Other drinks not included)

03DAY 3Tarangire to Central Serengeti NP

After breakfast, say goodbye to Tarangire and begin your journey to the Central Serengeti. The drive is full of beautiful scenery & quiet villages, open plains, and the chance to spot wildlife along the way. As you reach the Serengeti, the vast grasslands stretch endlessly before you, setting the stage for an exciting adventure in one of Africa’s most famous safari destinations.

Stay Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included Drinking water (Other drinks not included)

04DAY 4Central Serengeti NP

Spend a full day exploring the endless plains of the Central Serengeti, where wildlife roams freely across the golden savannah. Enjoy game drives at your own pace, watching lions bask in the sun, elephants wandering in herds, and cheetahs sprinting across the open plains. With every turn, the Serengeti reveals something new, making each moment an unforgettable part of your safari adventure.

Stay Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included Drinking water (Other drinks not included)

05DAY 5Central Serengeti NP to Ngorongoro Crater

Leave the Central Serengeti and travel towards Ngorongoro. Descend into the crater for wildlife viewing among grasslands, lakes and volcanic scenery. Continue to Kitela Lodge for the night.

Stay Kitela Lodge

06DAY 6Ngorongoro Crater to Arusha

As your safari comes to an end, enjoy a scenic drive back to Arusha. Along the way, take in the final views of Tanzania’s beautiful landscapes. Depending on your schedule, you can stop by local markets to shop for souvenirs and handmade crafts before continuing to your hotel or the airport for your onward journey or ending your adventure with lasting memories of Africa’s wild beauty.

Stay No accommodation (End of tour)

Meals & drinks Breakfast & lunch (Dinner not included) Drinking water (Other drinks not included)
